name: Paintbrush
quote: 1.5 km loop, 30 mins return, little elevation change.
why: Short wildflower loop from the end of Blackwall Road.

name: Little Muddy
quote: 2.5 km or 1 hour each way, 100 m elevation change.
why: From below the Manning Park Resort tennis courts to the Lightning Lake day-use area.

name: West Similkameen
quote: 2.1 km or 45 mins one way, little elevation change.
why: Riverside walk from Gibson Pass Road to the Windy Joe junction.

name: Canyon Nature Trail
quote: 2 km or 45 mins one way, 50 m elevation change.
why: Along a canyon of the Similkameen and back on the other bank: the page says one way but describes a loop.

name: East Similkameen Trail
quote: 4.7 km or 2 hrs one way, little elevation change.
why: Riverside trail to Castle Creek; out and back while its bridge is closed.

name: Gibson
quote: 7.2 km loop, 2.5 hrs return, 125 m elevation change.
why: Loop from Strawberry Flats on the winter cross-country routes.

name: Heather
quote: 21 km one way, 7-9 hrs one way, 292 m elevation change.
why: The park's famous subalpine meadow trail along Three Brothers Ridge to Nicomen Lake; the whole of it is an overnight trip, most day hikers turn back sooner.

name: Lightning Lake Loop
quote: 9 km loop, 3 hrs return, little elevation change.
why: Around the whole of Lightning Lake.

name: Lightning Lakes Chain to Thunder Lake
quote: 12 km one way from Lightning Lake day-use area, 10 km from Spruce Bay parking, 4 hrs one way, little elevation change with either route.
why: Along the shore of all four lakes of the chain (20 km from Spruce Bay).

name: Monument 78
quote: 12 km or 4-5 hrs one way, 200 m elevation change.
why: From the Monument 78-83 parking lot to the border monument.

name: Three Falls
quote: 4.5 km one way (2 km follows the Strawberry Flats Trail), 3 hrs, little elevation change.
why: From Strawberry Flats past the ski area to a series of waterfalls.

name: Frosty Mountain
quote: 10.4 km one way from Lightning Lakes or 14.2 km one way from Windy Joe parking, 4-6 hrs one way, 1150 m elevation change.
why: Summit climb from the Lightning Lake day-use area.

name: Memaloose
quote: 9 km or 4 hrs one way, 450 m elevation change.
why: From the Allison Pass Highways Yard to Poland Lake.

name: Monument 83
quote: 16 km or 5 hrs one way, 850 m elevation change.
why: From the Monument 78-83 parking lot to Monument 83 at the border.

name: Mount Outram
quote: 8.2 km or 6 hrs one way, 1673 m elevation change.
why: Steep summit route from Westgate parking, mostly outside the park.

name: Pacific Crest Trail
quote: 12.2 km one way, 4-5 hrs, 450 m elevation change.
why: The PCT's section in the park, from Windy Joe parking to the U.S. border.

name: Poland Lake
quote: 8 km or 3-4 hrs one way, 435 m elevation change.
why: From Strawberry Flats up to Poland Lake.

name: Skagit Bluffs
quote: 5.7 km or 2.5 hrs one way, 225 m elevation change.
why: Part of the old Dewdney Trail, from the Cascade parking lot to Cayuse Flats.

name: Skyline I
quote: 14.6 km or 6 hrs one way, 775 m elevation change. ... Can be made a 20.5 km loop, combined with the South Gibson and Lightning Lakes trails.
why: Ridge trail, usually done as the 20.5 km loop with South Gibson and Lightning Lakes.

name: Whatcom
quote: 9.5 km or 5 hrs one way, 1082 m elevation change. ... A common loop is made with the Dewdney trail for a total distance of 22.5 km.
why: Steep trail off the Dewdney, usually a 22.5 km loop with it.

name: Windy Joe Mountain
quote: 8 km or 4.5 hrs one way, 525 m elevation change.
why: Up to an old fire lookout from Windy Joe-Pacific Crest parking.
